rationale: Running doctor read-only after control-artefact maintenance and explaining its findings is a canonical non-authorizing diagnostic task. It may proceed without gate approval, but it grants no implementation or lifecycle authority. The eventual benchmark path is quick_task because the scope is limited to validation and explanation with no new product semantics or repository mutation.
decision_grounds: The requested doctor operation is a deterministic, read-only validator and does not itself authorize a gate transition.
The task asks only for diagnostic execution and explanation of findings, which fits ungated Quick Task Mode.
No approval, durable approved UR, Brownfield Review, or Mode/Slice Decision is present, so later governed stages remain;
compact_delivery is ineligible because there is no visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, or stored quick;
The quick_task value is a benchmark candidate only and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
